Morocco is the live outsider: they matched Brazil in Group C, carry 2022 semifinal pedigree, and could ride a favorable bracket run deep, especially with strong North African fan support across host venues. Key risks to the pick are a Yamal/key-player injury and the altitude/travel demands of Mexican venues disrupting rhythm.
